Due to the weight of this item, it will require assistance with unloading & moving at point of delivery.

Durable interlocking mat made of high-grade rubber. Water-resistant and easy to wash and clean. Built with large hexagonal drainage holes that reduce the amount of slippery liquids and oils left on the floor. Suitable for use in bars, kitchens, restaurants, as well as warehouses and other industrial areas where moisture and heavy foot fall occur.
